278682018.description: This listing features two vintage briar tobacco pipes. The first is a British Sovereign model with a smooth finish and a black vulcanite stem marked XXX, showing significant wear and patina. The second pipe has a rusticated finish with a dark brown to black stem and also displays heavy use signs including carbon build-up in the bowls and wear on the stems. Both pipes have visible imperfections consistent with age and use, suitable for restoration or display.

278535868.description: Vintage mineral and rock collection displayed in a wooden compartment tray. The tray measures 20 x 14 x 2 inches and contains various mineral and rock specimens, each in its own section with identification cards showing names, collection numbers, and locality information. Specimens include quartz, amethyst, malachite, agate, garnet, and others with a variety of colors and crystal forms. The item is used, with some labeling and slight wear on the wooden tray. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or display.

279097241.description:
Lot of three boxed Diplomat writing sets. Two sets in autumn forest print boxes each hold a burgundy lacquer pen and a matching mechanical pencil with gold tone trim, resting on a wooden stand. The third set in a green box holds a black and gold tone fountain pen, a matching pen and a black leather card holder. Untested, sold as is.

Condition: Clear tape is stuck across the pens in both burgundy sets. Boxes show light wear. Ink, nibs and pencil mechanisms have not been checked.

279229060.description: This lot includes a large assortment of collectible minerals, fossils, gemstones, and decorative items. Two boxed collections labeled 'Collection des Mineraux' and 'Collection des Fossiles' feature identified specimens such as quartz, calcite, amethyst, ammonite, and shark tooth. The set also contains loose mineral and gemstone samples including azurite, quartz, agate, malachite, geode, dolomite, and more, some stored in plastic bags. Included is a boxed amethyst Gua Sha muscle scraper by Inner Path, a gemstone tree sculpture with rose quartz leaves, tumbled stones, crystal clusters, and handmade gemstone jewelry like a wire-wrapped tree of life pendant and a crystal bracelet. Items are in good collectible condition with minor wear from handling and age. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology and natural history enthusiasts.

278962294.description:
Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators
This set includes three vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.
